cases.sql:
with diff_count as (
    SELECT
        1 as id,
        COUNT(*) as num_missing FROM (
            (SELECT "id", "name", "some_date" FROM "{{schema}}"."base" EXCEPT
             SELECT "id", "name", "some_date" FROM "{{schema}}"."view_model")
             UNION ALL
            (SELECT "id", "name", "some_date" FROM "{{schema}}"."view_model" EXCEPT
             SELECT "id", "name", "some_date" FROM "{{schema}}"."base")
        ) as a
), table_a as (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as num_rows FROM "{{schema}}"."base"
), table_b as (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as num_rows FROM "{{schema}}"."view_model"
), row_count_diff as (
    select
        1 as id,
        table_a.num_rows - table_b.num_rows as difference
    from table_a, table_b
)
select
    row_count_diff.difference as row_count_difference,
    diff_count.num_missing as num_mismatched
from row_count_diff
join diff_count using (id)
